token_set.name: Hometown History: Dallas Stars
token_set.description: Introducing Hometown History: Dallas Stars, a compilation of highlights commemorating historical moments celebrated by the Stars during the 2023-24 season.  These collectibles not only honor the rich history of the team but also rewind the clock to capture the players and achievements that solidify the franchise in the hearts of fans, and within the pages of NHL history.

description:
After tying Phil Housley's record for the most points by an American-born player in NHL history with a goal in the opening minutes of the Stars' game against the San Jose Sharks on Nov. 7, 2007, Mike Modano made history a little more than two minutes later. With the Stars on the penalty kill, Modano chipped a loose puck past Sharks defenseman Matt Carle and raced in on a breakaway. With a deke to the backhand, Modano slipped the puck past Sharks goaltender Evgeni Nabokov to become the highest-scoring U.S.-born player of all time.
